topPRs.title: fix(SuperchainAddressRegistry): discover the v8.0.0 super-root games
topPRs.author: OptimismBot
topPRs.body:
## Problem

`stacked_simulation_sep` and `forge_test` are failing on `main` with

```
Error: script failed: SuperchainAddressRegistry: zero address for PermissionedDisputeGame
```

([job 211255](https://circleci.com/gh/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/211255), [job 211261](https://circleci.com/gh/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/211261)). The trigger commit is unrelated — the same SHA was green two hours earlier in [job 211230](https://circleci.com/gh/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/211230).

The cause is on-chain, not in the repo: [`src/tasks/sep/108-U20-op-ink-soneium-uni`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/tree/main/src/tasks/sep/108-U20-op-ink-soneium-uni) has executed. Upgrade 20 clears `CANNON` (0), `PERMISSIONED_CANNON` (1) and `CANNON_KONA` (8) and installs `SUPER_CANNON_KONA` (9) plus `SUPER_PERMISSIONED` (5). `_saveDisputeGameEntries` guards the fault game (`src/SuperchainAddressRegistry.sol:373`) but read the permissioned game unconditionally (`src/SuperchainAddressRegistry.sol:378`), so discovery now reverts for OP, Ink, Soneium and Unichain Sepolia. Verified on OP Sepolia's `DisputeGameFactoryProxy` [`0x05F9613aDB30026FFd634f38e5C4dFd30a197Fa1`](https://sepolia.etherscan.io/address/0x05F9613aDB30026FFd634f38e5C4dFd30a197Fa1): `gameImpls(0)` and `gameImpls(1)` are `address(0)`, `gameImpls(5)` = `0x5C3eb47cB0174aea522a2a9Ae79487139A53D691`, `gameImpls(9)` = `0x19AF533Cc2A2A55786DCB8672aA5717e64213208`.

## Change

`src/SuperchainAddressRegistry.sol` — guard the permissioned game the way the fault game already is, and fall back to the super games:

- Register `SuperFaultDisputeGame` (9) and `SuperPermissionedDisputeGame` (5) when the legacy games are cleared. Those names match the ones already used in the U20 validation files.
- Resolve the shared roles — `AnchorStateRegistryProxy`, `MIPS`, `PreimageOracle`, `PermissionlessWETH`, `Proposer` — through the super games' `gameArgs`. The legacy permissioned game is still preferred, so pre-U20 chains keep their current entries exactly.
- Only register `Challenger` and `PermissionedWETH` when the legacy permissioned game exists. `SuperPermissionedDisputeGame` is bondless and proposer-only: its args are just `anchorStateRegistry | proposer`, so neither role exists on-chain after the upgrade.
- `SUPER_PERMISSIONED` args are 40 bytes, not the 124/164-byte layout, so they get their own decoder (`_tryDecodeSuperPermissionedGameArgs`).
- Only register `MIPS` and `PreimageOracle` when a game that carries a VM exists — the legacy permissioned game, the legacy fault game, or the super fault game. Upgrade 20 leaves `SUPER_CANNON_KONA` (9) disabled on a chain that had no `CANNON_KONA` impl to carry over, so that chain is left with `SUPER_PERMISSIONED` (5) alone and has no VM at all: registering `MIPS` unconditionally reverted its discovery with `zero address for MIPS`. [sepolia-devnet-3](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/tree/main/src/tasks/sep/107-U20-sepolia-devnet-2-3) is in this state today, and Soneium will be once [eth/071](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/tree/main/src/tasks/eth/071-U20-op-ink-soneium-uni) executes (`startingRespectedGameType = 5`).

`test/registry/SuperchainAddressRegistry.t.sol` — accept the super games in `assertAddresses` and require `MIPS`/`PreimageOracle` only for a chain that has a fault game. Adds `test_superRootGamesDiscovered_opSepolia` for the post-U20 OP Sepolia shape, and `SuperchainAddressRegistryTest_SuperPermissionedOnly`, a pinned-fork case (sepolia-devnet-3 at block `11700000`) where the super permissioned game, its `AnchorStateRegistryProxy` and its `Proposer` resolve while `MIPS`, `PreimageOracle`, `PermissionedDisputeGame` and `Challenger` are absent.

Resulting OP Sepolia entries:

| Identifier | Address | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `SuperFaultDisputeGame` | `0x19AF533Cc2A2A55786DCB8672aA5717e64213208` | `gameImpls(9)` |
| `SuperPermissionedDisputeGame` | `0x5C3eb47cB0174aea522a2a9Ae79487139A53D691` | `gameImpls(5)` |
| `AnchorStateRegistryProxy` | `0xa1Cec548926eb5d69aa3B7B57d371EdBdD03e64b` | `gameArgs(9)` / `gameArgs(5)` |
| `MIPS` | `0xaCc005DCd857B401e4732E6F7837135A22825cfA` | `gameArgs(9)` |
| `PreimageOracle` | `0x1E1d73536A081Ef2F355d29794547a9770Aeb1E0` | `MIPS.oracle()` |
| `PermissionlessWETH` | `0xF6900d822268F011d085191fe1abc6B557038eB7` | `gameArgs(9)` |
| `Proposer` | `0x49277EE36A024120Ee218127354c4a3591dc90A9` | `gameArgs(5)` |

## Verification

- Both `gameArgs` decoders were run against OP Sepolia's live `gameArgs(5)` (40 bytes) and `gameArgs(9)` (124 bytes) payloads in a standalone Foundry harness, and produce the addresses in the table above. The 124/164-byte decoder correctly ignores the 40-byte payload.
- `forge fmt --check` is clean on both files under the repo's pinned `forge 1.1.0`.
- The type-5-only shape was confirmed on-chain at the pinned block: devnet-3's DisputeGameFactory `0xbDE04Dc0b4DbdA6A1A60B0Bf5F32262e129523Ea` has only `gameImpls(5)` set, with `gameArgs(5)` = `0x764138B0…Ff99` (ASR) ‖ `0x7824594364cDd4ee…604a` (proposer).
- The suite itself was **not** run here: it needs the submodules plus the archive-RPC forks, which exceed this sandbox. CI is the check that matters — `forge_test` and `stacked_simulation_sep` should both go green.

`src/tasks/sep/108-U20-op-ink-soneium-uni/README.md` is also marked `[EXECUTED]`, pointing at [`0x788dfac2…a603c4a`](https://sepolia.etherscan.io/tx/0x788dfac2ac1b025b31a95b72336e7435fd192a352af8aec302a7d3907a603c4a) — the successful `execTransaction` from the standard L1PAO `0x1Eb2fFc903729a0F03966B917003800b145F56E2` in block `11724769`, the same block in which the four chains' `PERMISSIONED_CANNON` implementations were cleared. #1553 made the same change and has been closed as superseded.
